Iya inde ia baine napogau' loppo'um ia indo malanna napogau'. Aka inde natolloiä' minnä'-minnä'na temo, napogau' loppo'um ia indo la dipogau' ke dilamummä'.
Setongam-tonganna, umba-umba naongei Kaheba Katilallasam dipa'pakahebaam, etam too duka' la dipotulasam pa'pogausanna inde baine anna mala dikilalai liu.”
Deem mesa to tihekem sapulo dua passikolanna Puang Yesus isanga Yudas Iskariot, le'ba' umpellambi'i sanaka-naka kapala sando aka illaam penabanna maelo' la umbalu' Puang Yesus.
Sangngim kassi uhhingngii anna ma'dandi la nabeem doi'. Iya umpeä lium lalam Yudas la umbalu' Puang Yesus.

Illaam pa'pahandusanna allo kasalle Hoti Tä' Diboloi Bibi' Hoti si ditunu domba pengkilalaam Kalappasanna to Yahudi dio mai Kasabuasam. Allo eta too ma'kada passikolanna lako Puang Yesus naua: “La lu umbakam ngei umpatokaangko kinande indo si diande ke umpengkilalai tau allo Kalappasam?”
Iya ussuam dua passikolanna naua: “Le'ba'koa' libam kota Yerusalem, iya la silambi'ungkoa' too mesa muane umbaba busso kessi uwai. Tuhu'ia'
lako banua naongei anna muuaannia' indo to ma'banua: Nauaangkam Tuangguhu: ‘Uaanni: Umba ngei tambim to bali umpatoka la kiongei sola Tuangguhungki mangngande kinande allo Kalappasam?’
Iya la napaitaingkoa' too mesa tambim kalua' tando längäm puha asammi napatoka sule lako pangkakka'. Etanna' too la muongei ma'patoka.”
Iya le'ba'um indo dua passikola libam Yerusalem. Sulei libam, nalambi' si'da susi liu indo tula'na Puang Yesus. Iya napatokam indo kinande si diande illaam allo Kalappasam.
Bengii, sulem Puang Yesus umpasola sapulo dua passikolanna.
Mahassanni mangngande, iya nauam Puang Yesus: “Setongam-tonganna, deem mesa solamua' illaam inde alla'-alla'taa' la umbalu'ä'.”
Iya sangngim masussa penabanna anna sibala'-bala'i mekutana naua: “Taia mammaka kao, Tuangguhu?”
Natimba'im naua: “Sala'-sala' mennammua' inde to sapulo duakoa'. Iai too kusolapihingam unduho hoti, iya iam too.

Abana hi tia Kao to disangai Änä' Mentolino inna la mateä', umba susi puha tisuha' illaam Battakada Debata. Sapo' tä' deem pada satilaka lako indo to umbalu'ä'. Mala leko'um ia kela tä'um ia didadiam!”

Mahassanni mangngande, iya mualam mesa hoti Puang Yesus anna nakuhhu'i sumanga' längäm Puang Allataala mane napiä'-piä'i anna nabeenni lako passikolanna napasindum naua: “Iam too inde baleku, alaia' ammu andei.”
Puhai, mualam mesa ihusam kessi anggur anna nakuhhu'i sumanga' mane nabeem oi lako passikolanna. Iya naalam duka' anna nasibala'-bala'i naihu'.
Anna mane ma'kadai naua: “Iam too inde hahaku la dipatitollo la umpomannassa pa'dandianna Puang Allataala lako buda tau.
Setonganna kutulasangkoa': Tä'mä' Kao deem la muihu' pole anggur sampe lambi' wattunna la muihu'ä' anggur bakahu illaam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala.”
Puhai, iya umpenaniammi mesa pampujiam, mane le'ba'i längäm Tanete Zaitun.

Iya umpatahhu'um tula'na Puang Yesus lako passikolanna naua: “La le'ba'koa' umpelleiä' aka deem tisuha' illaam Battakada Debata naua: ‘La kupatei to ma'kambi'na anna ingganna dombana la tisembu' lao.’
Sapo' maka' too dipatibangommä' sule, la kupendioloikoa' lako Galilea.”
Iya ma'kadam Petrus naua: “Moi la le'ba' asam solaku napelleiko, inna tä' sia kao deem la kupelleiko.”
Natimba' Puang Yesus naua: “Setongam-tonganna, illaam inde bengi tä'pi la penduam moni mäne' anna pentallummä' umbahoi.”
Sapo' tuttuam napomatohhä mandi duka' pa'kadanna Petrus naua: “Toko moiä' kao la dipatei solaki', tala kubahoiko!” Anna ingganna solana Petrus ma'kada susi siam duka'.
Puhai ia too, iya le'ba'um Puang Yesus sola passikolanna lu lako mesa ongeam isanga Getsemani. Dioi, muuaammi passikolanna: “Okko'ungkoa' too eta inde anna laopä' ma'sambajam.”
Umbabaim Petrus sola Yakobus anna Yohanes napasola. Tä' deem pada samahea' Puang Yesus anna husa' penabanna nasi'dim.
Nauam: “Masussa si'da-si'da penabangku kusi'dim, angga' la mateä'. Tohhongkoa' too eta inde, sapo' tä'koa' la lembe.”
Iya mentudendem saidi' anna untapposanni kalena dokko litä' napasindum ma'sambajam kela mala anna lappa'i dio mai kamasussaam ia too.
Naua: “O Papa', O Ambeku, tä' Iko deem aka ungkapusa'i ke umpoelo'i. Lappasannä' dio mai inde kamasussaam kuoloi temo, sapo' la pa'elo'mu dadi, taia la pa'elo'ku.”

Puhai ma'sambajam ma'pasulem. Iya ullambi'um indo to tallu to napasola ingngena' mahassam mamma'. Iya ma'kadam lako Petrus naua: “Simon, mamma'ko isanga? Tä' dakoka tiko mala majaga moi podo satette'um?
Majagakoa' ammu pa'sambajam indana napa'sändä'ikoa' setam. Aka abana hi tia mohäe penabammua' la umpalako kamaloloam, sapo' napomalammakoa' sipa' hupataummu.”
Anna mane le'ba' pole oo ma'sambajam, susi siam indo pa'sambajanna ingngena'.
Puhai, ma'pasule oom sule, iya nalambi' mamma' oo sule aka nataloi sugali'um matanna. Iya sangngim tä' bäbä naissam aka la naua mentimba'.

Tappana ma'pasule kapentallunna iya nauam: “Mamma' liupokoa' isanga? Tä' liupokoka' tiko malube! Sihuam tia! Aka lambi'um wattunna Kao to disangai Änä' Mentolino la dibehoä' tama pala' limanna to madosa.
Bangommokoa' anta laoa'. Petua'ia' diom mai indo to la umpopesakkaä'!”

Mahassampi ma'tula' Puang Yesus, iya sule ham Yudas indo to tihekem duka' sapulo dua passikolanna Puang Yesus umpasola tau buda sanda pa'dam sola bose, nasua kapala sando anna to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa sola matua ulunna to Yahudi.
Indo Yudas to umbalu'i, puham untula' loppo' tanda lako indo to napasola naua: “Iai too kuudum, iam too la ussakkaa' anna umbabai, sapo' jagai manappai.”
Iya landa'i lako, tappa umpellambi'im Puang Yesus anna nauai: “O Tuangguhu!” anna mane naudum, iya sikanasakkam.
Deem mesa tau eta too ussintä' pa'danna anna umbattai mesa sabua'na sando too', iya mäläi talinganna.
Iya ma'kadam Puang Yesus lako indo tau buda naua: “Ussangaa' isanga pehampo'ä' anna sulekoa' sanda pa'dam sanda bose la ussakkaä'?
Kusanga allo-allokoa' kupa'guhu illaam Banua Debata iya tä' dä' ussakka. Sapo' abana hi tia la susi anna mala sule lako indo puha tisuha' illaam Battakada Debata.”
Iya sikalumpa'um lao ingganna indo passikolanna napellei.
Deem mesa änä' muane anggam sambu' illaam kalena le'ba' ia untuhu' Puang Yesus. Naanda'im duka' tau buda la nasakka,
sapo' nalappa' indo sambu'na anna lumumpa'i lao ma'kambelä bäbä.
Iya dipasolam Puang Yesus lako sando too'. Eta too ma'hempum ingganna kapala sando anna matua ulunna to Yahudi sola to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa.
Iya natuhu' kalamba'um Petrus sule lako pa'hanteanna sando too' anna muokko'i mendähä sola to unjagai Banua Debata.

Iya umpalilimmi tangnga' kapala sando sola ingganna solana to tihekem duka' To Mahhotto'na to Yahudi la umpeängam tuntungam su'be' Puang Yesus anna nadakasam pa'posanga-sanga anna mala dipatei, sapo' tä' deem nalambi'.
Budapi tau si umpakolo'-kolo'i Puang Yesus, sapo' tä' deem mala sipako-pako tula'na.
Sanaka-nakapi tau ke'de' uhhängänni pa'pakolo'-kolo'inna solana naua:
“Deem kihingngi tula'na inde tau naua: ‘La kukadakeam inde Banua Debata pa'papianna hupatau angku papia polei senga'na, la tallungngallo liu anna dadim aka taia pa'papia hupatau.’”
Sapo' tä' asam deem mala mentama tula'na.
Iya ke'de'um sando too' illaam alla'-alla'na tau anna ungkutanai Puang Yesus naua: “Tä' liu siam isanga la untimba'i inde lako pa'pahapa'na tau?”
Sapo' mengkamma' mandi Puang Yesus. Iya mekutana pole oom sando too' naua: “Iko si'da haka To dilanti' la mepasalama', Änä'na Puang Allataala To handam dipa'kasallei?”
Iya natimba'im naua: “Kaom too, anna illaam allo la taoloinna la muitakoa' Änä' Mentolino, battu diua Kao, la muokko' dio tandai kananna To Handam Kuasa anna la suleä' sule illaam gabum yabo langi'!”
Iya tappa umpessepäsam siaham pohebana sando too' aka keaha' anna nauai: “Akapi gunana la umpeä liukia' sa'bi?
Aka uhhingngi asammia' kadanna inde dio tau untelle Puang Allataala! Dadi maakaa' iko susi lalam penabammu?” Sangngim umpasala Puang Yesus anna nauai: “La dipatei.”
Iya deem sanaka-naka tau untikkudui anna mane nasapu'iam matanna anna nadänggu'i napasindum naua: “O nabi, pentopaipi, menna untappai limako?” Anna to ma'honda duka' untampilinni Puang Yesus.
Wattu eta too mahassampi dio pa'hanteam Petrus, iya sulem mesa baine sabua'na sando too'.
Tappana muita Petrus mahassam mendähä, iya napengkaleso-lesoim lindona anna nauaanni: “Iko duka' si sola liuko indo Yesus to Nazaret.”
Sapo' tappa ma'baho naua: “Tä' kuissam aka hi iko isanga untula',” anna le'ba'i lako olo ba'ba, [iya moni siaham mäne'].
Puhai ia too, naita pole oom mesa sabua' baine. Iya ma'kadam indo baine lako to dio heem eta too naua: “Inde dio tau abana solana.”
Iya nabahoi pole oom Petrus. Tä' masäe, iya ma'kadam duka' indo to dio heem eta too naua: “Mannassa anna solanako aka to Galileako duka'.”
Iya ma'pindam pole' Petrus naua: “Naitaä' Debata, kela kuissanni indo to muuaanna'!”
Iya moni siaham mäne' kapenduanna. Iya tappa nakilalaim pole' Petrus indo tula'na Puang Yesus naua: “Tä'pi la penduam moni mäne' anna pentallummä' umbahoi.” Iya ma'pase'go'um sumahho.

Mebengngi'-bengngi'pi anna umpasahandammi kada kapala sando sola matua ulunna to Yahudi anna to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa sola to si mahhotto' illaam peadasanna to Yahudi. Iya umpungom Puang Yesus anna nababai lako olona Pilatus.
Mekutanam Pilatus lako Puang Yesus naua: “Ikongka indo tomahajanna to Yahudi?” Natimba'um naua: “Ikom ma'kale muuai.”
Iya ma'tula'um ingganna kapala sando umpakolo'-kolo'i Puang Yesus.
Mekutana pole oom Pilatus naua: “Tä' isanga la untimba'i inde mai tau? Uhhingngi haka buda natandasangko?”
Sapo' tä' liu siam mentimba' nasuhum mängä-mängä bäbä Pilatus.
Maka' lambi' oom allo kasalle ia too, si biasa dilappasam mesa to ditahungkum situhu' pelauanna tau buda.
Wattu eta too deem mesa to ditahungkum isanga Barabas anna budapi solana to puha papateam aka umbali-bali to ma'pahenta.
Iya sulem tau buda melau lako Pilatus anna mala dipalako kaha-kaha ia too susi biasa.
Iya mekutanam Pilatus naua: “La muaku haka' ke kulappasanni inde tomahajanna to Yahudi?”
Ia anna ma'kada susii Pilatus aka naissam naua ia hi tia anna nababai sule ingganna indo kapala sando aka nakembuhui.
Sapo' umpatudui tau buda indo kapala sando naua: “Pelauia' anna mala Barabas dilappasam.”
Iya mekutana pole oom Pilatus lako indo tau buda naua: “Maka' susi, iya aka la kupogausam inde to ussangaia' tomahajanna to Yahudi?”
Iya sikatambam naua: “Päso'i yabo kaju sitambem anna malai mate!”
Mekutana pole oom Pilatus naua: “Anu' aka hia kasalaanna?” Sapo' tuttuam sikaoli mandi naua: “Päso'i yabo kaju sitambem anna malai mate!”
Mohäe Pilatus la umpalossosam penabanna tau buda lambi' ullappasam ia Barabas anna ussuai tau untembe' talukum Puang Yesus mane napesuaanni dipäso' yabo kaju sitambem.
Iya napasolam sohodadu Puang Yesus lako Banua Gubernur indo si diongei ma'bisaha, anna untambai asanni ingganna sohodadu ma'hempum.
Anna napapakei juba mellolo pao susi bajunna tomahaja anna muananni songko' susi songko'na tomahaja sapo' keduhi anna napasongko'ianni.
Anna mane napekatabe'i lelem naua: “O tomahajanna to Yahudi, kipa'kasalleiko!”
Nahabi' bulo ulunna, natikkudui anna ma'balinguntu' lelenni menomba.
Puhai natelle, naäläiammi sule indo juba mellolo pao napapakeiam anna napapohebai sule indo inna pohebana.
Wattu eta too deem mesa tau isanga Simon to Kirene, ambena Aleksander sola Rufus, mane sule dio mai sulibanna kota Yerusalem. Iya napassaim umpassam kaju sitambenna Puang Yesus.
Indo sohodadu umpasola Puang Yesus lako mesa ongeam isanga Golgota, kalembasanna ongeanna kahohä' ulu.
Anna mane nabeem anggur sihau mur, sapo' tä' naaku naihu'.
Iya napalängämmi kaju sitambem anna mane nataba-taba pohebana sapo' naundi.
Tette' kaseham mebengngi' anna dipalängänni kaju sitambem Puang Yesus.
Yabo indo kaju sitambenna dituli' kasuhunganna anna dipäso'i, naua: TOMAHAJANNA TO YAHUDI.
Deem duka' dua pehampo' nasimbahaam dipäso' yabo kaju sitambem, mesa dio tandai kananna anna mesa dio tandai kaihinna.[
Iya diganna'im issinna Battakadanna Puang Allataala naua: “La dihekem duka' mesa tau kadake illaam alla'na tau kadake.”]
Ingganna to muolai ongeam ia too si muillim-illim tandana untelle Puang Yesus napasindum naua: “Kusanga paha' la ungkadakeangko Banua Debata anna la tallungngallo muolaam umpake'de' sule!
Iya lappasangko kalemu anna tuhungko yabo mai itim kaju sitambem!”
Susi toi duka' kapala sando anna to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa sipa'tula'-tula' mantelle naua: “Maka' tau senga' mala napasalama', sapo' maka' kalena tä' ohi ia mala napasalama'.

Maka' abana si'da tomahajanna to Israel anna To nalanti' Puang Allataala, iya la tuhummi too yabo mai inde dio kaju sitambem anna mala taitaia' anta katappa'ia'.” Moi duka' indo to dua to nasimbahaam dipäso' yabo kaju sitambem untelle duka' Puang Yesus.
Tappana tängä allo, iya malillim pättäm dio indo pa'lembängam sule lako tette' tallu kahubem.
Tette' tallui kahubem, iya metambam Puang Yesus naua: “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakhtani?” Kalembasanna, O Puang Allataala, Debatangku, aka hi anna untampeannä'?
Nahingnginna petambana indo to ke'de' eta too, iya deemmi sanaka-naka muuai: “Pehingngiia'i, untambai nabi Elia!”

Iya napasihha'um mesa tau muala bunga karang anna nahammei dokko anggur maissu', mane napadekke'i lako pesoka anna napadu'dui pudu'na Puang Yesus napasindum naua: “Taampaipia' anna tapetua'ia' battu la sule si'da hi nalappasam Elia.”
Iya metamba pole oom mane kattui penabanna.
Wattu eta too, indo sampim pesapa' illaam Banua Debata tappa sesse' tipa'dua mengkalao yabo sule dokko.
Deem mesa punggabana sohodadu mahassam ke'de' dio olona Puang Yesus. Tappana naitai maaka susi kamateanna, iya nauam: “Abana Änä'na si'da hia päläe' Puang Allataala!”
Deem duka' sanaka-naka baine umpetua' mambelai, susinna Maria Magdalena, Salome, anna Maria indona Yakobus Mangnguha sola Yoses.
Baine ia too sangngim to untuhu'um Puang Yesus, anna si natahiai indo anna si diopi Galilea. Anna budapi baine senga' dio duka' heem eta too, to napasola sule dio Yerusalem.
Allo eta too allo pa'patokaam la mentama allo Katohhoam. Tappana mahammo,

iya deemmi mesa tau isanga Yusuf to Arimatea, mesa to kasalle illaam bilanganna To Mahhotto' Handam Malangka', napengkasahai umpellambi'i Pilatus anna umpelaui bakkena Puang Yesus. Indo Yusuf mesa to masäe allom muampai kapahentaanna Puang Allataala.
Mängä-mängä Pilatus tappana napekaheba diua matem Puang Yesus. Iya untambaim pangngulunna sohodadu anna nakutanai naua: “Mate si'dangka Yesus?”
Tappana nahingngi pa'tula'na, iya umpäbäim Yusuf lao muala bakkena Puang Yesus.
Iya muallim sampim mabusa Yusuf anna laoi napatuhum anna nabalunni. Anna mane laoi napandam tama lokko' dipapia dio mesa tanete batu. Puhai, iya ullolimmi batu kasalle natutu'iam ba'bana.
Indo ongeam dipampandanni bakkena naita Maria Magdalena sola Maria indona Yoses.
Tappana lessu' allo Katohhoam, muallim bauam bubanau' Maria Magdalena anna Maria indona Yakobus anna Salome aka la lao nasussuiam bakkena Puang Yesus illaam lokko'.
Buttunna allo indo allo Minggu eta too, iya le'ba'im lako ku'bu'.
Iya sipa'tula'-tula'um naua: “Mennangkia' la umbehoiam indo batu pelapa'na ku'bu'?”
Sapo' mahuku'i lako, iya naitam indo batu dilapasam ba'ba lokko' puham dilolim lao.
Iya le'ba'im tama indo ku'bu', iya naitam mesa to mangnguha ma'poheba mabusa muokko' dio tandai kanam, iya sileleim tikkedu' anna mängä-mängä.
Sapo' ma'kada indo to mangnguha naua: “Daa ummahea'a'! Kuissam kuua umpeäkoa' Yesus to Nazaret indo to puha dipäso' yabo kaju sitambem, sapo' pa'dem inde aka tubom sule. Petua'ia' indem ongeanna.
Dadi le'ba'ungkoa' temo anna umpaissanni Petrus sola passikola senga'na muua: ‘Mendiolom ia lako Galilea Puang Yesus, diopi mane silambi'koa' umba susi puha nauaangkoa'.’”
Iya le'ba'i siaham sikalumpa' umpellei indo lokko' aka tikkedu' lambi' lumalla' mahea' muita kadadiam ia too. Tandana mahea'i, iya tä' deem natula' lako tau.
[Tappana puha tubo sule Puang Yesus indo mebengngi'-bengngi' allo Minggu eta too, iya uhu-uhuna umpa'paitaam kalena lu lako Maria Magdalena indo to puha nahambaiam pitu setam illaam mai kalena.
Iya tappa le'ba'um indo baine napa'paissangam lako ingganna to si untuhu'i anu' mahassannipi ma'bahata anna tää'i liupi tipoli' uwai matanna wattu eta too.
Sapo' tappana sikanahingngi naua tubom sule Puang Yesus anna deemmi umpa'paitaam kalena, tä' liu siaham nakannangam.
Lessu'i eta too umpa'paitaam pole oom kalena, sapo' senga'um hupanna, lako dua pentuhu'na wattunna anna le'ba'i umpellei tondä'.
Iya ma'pasulem sule aka la natula' lako solana indo pangngitanna. Sapo' tää'i liupi kannam.
Katampasanna umpa'paitaam kalena lako sapulo mesa passikolanna wattunna mahassanni mangngande. Sangngim nasosso Puang Yesus aka tä' ungkannangam pa'tula'na to puha muitai katuboanna sule.
Iya ma'kadam Puang Yesus lako naua: “Le'ba'koa' lako lili'-lili'na lino ammu pa'pakahebaannia' Kaheba Katilallasam lako ingganna hupatau.
Menna-menna ungkatappa'i anna ditedo'i iam too la salama', sapo' menna-menna tä' matappa' la ditahungkum ia.
Tanda-tandana to matappa' mala la umpogau' susinna: uhhambai lao setam umpake sangangku, anna la umpake basa maneanna natula', napalosaiam Penaba Maseho.
Moi anna la muanda'i ula' battu la muihu' hasum sapo' tä' la mala nasägäi, anna la uhhaka' to masaki napolalam bono'.”
Puhai ma'tula' lako passikolanna, iya tiäkä'um längäm suhuga anna muokko'i dio tandai kananna Puang Allataala.
Iya le'ba'im passikolanna umpa'pakahebaam Kaheba Katilallasam lako si mesa-mesa ongeam illaam lino anna napasolai Debata mengkähä umpakatoto' kadanna napa'patandaam umpadadi tanda memängä-mängä.]
